title: The 5 Best Food Dehydrators Under $80
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for food dehydrators under $80, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at food dehydrators under $80 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: NESCO FD-75A Snackmaster Pro Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: Adjustable thermostat, 95°F to 160°F, 5 trays included, expandable to 12, 600W top-mounted fan with Converga-Flow.
strengths: 160°F ceiling covers jerky, fruit, vegetables, and herbs in one machine
Expandable tray system scales up without replacing the whole unit
One of the best-selling and longest-running dehydrators on the market
Compact footprint fits easily on a counter or in a cabinet
limitations: 5-tray starting capacity is modest without buying add-on trays
Top-mounted fan needs tray rotation for even drying
No digital display, uses an analog dial for temperature

products.name: Presto 06301 Dehydro Digital Electric Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: Digital thermostat and timer, 90°F to 165°F, 6 trays included, expandable to 12, Bottom-mounted fan.
strengths: Digital timer and thermostat are easier to read and set precisely than an analog dial
165°F ceiling covers meat safe-start temperatures with room to spare
Nesting trays make this the most compact of the budget picks to store
Includes mesh screens and fruit roll sheets in the box, no extra accessory purchase
limitations: Bottom-mounted fan means the lowest tray dries fastest
6-tray starting capacity, similar limitation to the NESCO for larger batches
Slightly higher typical price than the NESCO
features: Nesting trays, over 40% smaller footprint stored
